steps.text: Whisk {buckwheat-flour} with {salt}. Whisk in {water-paste} to a thick paste, smoothing out the lumps.
Whisk in {water-thin} until the batter is fluid and spreads easily. Whisk in {egg} until fully combined.
Press plastic film directly onto the surface and rest in the fridge, up to 12 h for maximum hydration.
Whisk the batter briefly. Heat a pan over medium-high heat until a drop of water sizzles instantly.
Grease the pan with {butter}, a thin film for each galette. Pour a thin layer of batter, swirl fast and cook until the surface looks dry and the edges are well browned.
Flip and cook until browned with spots and the galette feels drier and crisper. For extra crispness, flip once more briefly to dry the first side again.
Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the pan each time. If the galettes tear, whisk a little more buckwheat flour into the batter; if it has thickened, a little water.
